name: v3_cno_darcy
_comment: CNO RPB Darcy_64x64_IN.h5, all 512 samples stacked losslessly: input = a (values 3 or 12), output = u as stored. -div(a grad u) = 1, u = 0 on the boundary (Raonic et al. 2023, eq. 4.7; same set-up as FNO). Note: the stored output is <= 0 everywhere (file constants min_out -0.023, max_out 0.0), i.e. it has the sign of -u for the documented equation; kept as released.
